headline: Last session: Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into red; NTPC terminated major contract and Paytm remained in focus.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Sensex faced downward pressure and slipped into the red following the Closing Auction Session (CAS).
Nifty 50 showed resilience, managing to close with a gain of 75 points despite broader market volatility.
Concerns over tighter H-1B visa scrutiny weighed on the sentiment for major Indian IT service providers.
Investors remained cautious ahead of the weekend, focusing on FII trends and fluctuating crude oil prices.
whatHappening: NTPC terminated a ₹413 crore BESS contract due to the contractor's failure to meet obligations and progress.
The government has mandated Aadhaar biometric authentication for LPG subsidies effective from October 1.
Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will remain shut until Tuesday, September 22.
Analysts are identifying support levels for Sensex and Nifty as they prepare for the upcoming trading week.

summary:
The Indian markets concluded the last trading session with mixed results as the Nifty gained 75 points while the Sensex ended in the red.
Key developments included NTPC's contract termination and new US visa restrictions, which are expected to impact the domestic IT sector.
Trading is currently suspended for the weekend, with the market set to resume on Tuesday, September 22, amid focus on global cues.
